languageParity: All public/frontend output must carry HR and EN versions with the same substance.
presentationRule: Outputs are presented through worker roles, desks, companies and projects, not as AI-authored public content.

hr: Svaki dan se otvara novi dnevni radni ciklus za sve workere.
Stari zadaci se pregledavaju, zatvaraju, vraćaju u rad ili dijele na manje zadatke.
Novi zadaci se dodjeljuju svim workerima prema projektu, funkciji, prioritetu i kapacitetu.
Ako zadatak nema vlasnika, Worker Operations Desk ga odmah dodjeljuje odgovornom workeru.
Ako je projekt preopterećen, posao se dijeli na više workera i više manjih zadataka.
Nema statusa 'nema tko raditi'; za svaki projekt postoji minimalni dnevni worker pokrivač.
en: Each day opens a new daily operating cycle for all workers.
Old tasks are reviewed, closed, returned to work or split into smaller tasks.
New tasks are assigned to all workers by project, function, priority and capacity.
If a task has no owner, Worker Operations Desk immediately assigns it to the responsible worker.
If a project is overloaded, work is split across more workers and smaller tasks.
There is no 'no one to work on it' status; every project has minimum daily worker coverage.

operatingCycles.hr: Jutarnji ciklus: pregled starih zadataka, zatvaranje gotovog, vraćanje nedovršenog u rad, dodjela novih zadataka svim workerima i novi okvir dana.
operatingCycles.en: Morning cycle: review old tasks, close completed work, return unfinished work to execution, assign new tasks to all workers and set the daily frame.

operatingCycles.hr: Srednji ciklus: provjera izvršenja, preraspodjela ako negdje stoji, publication queue, media prijave, blokade i ručni review.
operatingCycles.en: Midday cycle: check execution, reassign work if blocked, publication queue, media applications, blocks and manual review.

operatingCycles.hr: Večernji ciklus: zatvaranje dana, izvješće, naučene lekcije, novi okvir za sutra i zadaci koji se prenose.
operatingCycles.en: Evening cycle: close the day, report, lessons learned, new frame for tomorrow and carried-over tasks.
